signals_info.description: Signed lateral displacement from the lane center.

nl_Literal_translation_en: For the next 10 seconds, the lane offset shall remain greater than -0.3 meters and less than 0.3 meters.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在接下来的 10 秒内，车道横向偏移应始终大于 -0.3 米且小于 0.3 米。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the 10-second lane-keeping observation window, the magnitude of the lateral displacement from the lane center shall remain strictly below 0.3 meters.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在 10 秒的车道保持观测窗口内，车辆相对车道中心的横向偏移绝对值应持续严格小于 0.3 米。
